universe_definition: The 46 controls in the auditar-web-ue-espana control catalog. Project-specific age, image-rights and sector-advertising findings are reported separately and are not added to this catalog denominator.
classification_rule: Each catalog control appears exactly once. EXECUTED means that at least a scoped applicability or technical review was performed and a result could be stated, including PARTIAL or INCONCLUSIVE. NOT_TESTED means that the control was selected but the required runtime, procedure, tool or human test was unavailable. NOT_APPLICABLE_CURRENT_SNAPSHOT is a reversible snapshot classification with an explicit reopen trigger. NOT_SELECTED means no substantive control execution and no exclusion conclusion.

Static review and tests of fail-closed publication, evidence references, public-data projection, durable local audit/replay controls, bounded image processing, structural MP4 validation, media integrity, cooperative local-filesystem locks and integrity-checked backup/restore. The locks coordinate cooperating processes only, are not distributed and never auto-remove stale locks; these local controls are not a production security assessment.

The last durable local release verification remains bound to checkpoint 95 at commit 15d56f0e5812a06e03dea781487f7553ce010a5c. The current working candidate declares 98/100 and adds an exact es/en/fr/it locale contract, deterministic catalog validation and a complementary multilingual catalog audit, but it is not yet commit-bound by a new evidence manifest. No rendered-DOM, staging, deployed operational quality measurement, linguistic approval or acceptance is inferred.

Static review of locale-prefixed es/en/fr/it routes, same-locale canonical and reciprocal base-code hreflang logic behind the aggregate publication gate, plus the prior local production smoke for neutral metadata, noindex, disallow-all and an empty sitemap. The complementary catalog audit is NO DETERMINABLE for technical multilingual publication and does not test rendered DOM, deployed destinations, crawlability, semantic equivalence, indexing or rankings.
